required.quote: As a condition of renewal of a license, a licensee must complete continuing education requirements established by rule of the Department.

available.quote: The Department may issue a license as a genetic counselor, without administering the required examination, to an applicant licensed under the laws of another state, a U.S. territory, or another country if the requirements for licensure in that state, U.S. territory, or country are, on the date of licensure, substantially equal to the requirements of this Act

requirements.value: Applicant must be licensed in another state, U.S. territory, or country with substantially equal requirements, or possess individually substantially equivalent qualifications; all required fees must be paid.
requirements.quote: to an applicant licensed under the laws of another state, a U.S. territory, or another country if the requirements for licensure in that state, U.S. territory, or country are, on the date of licensure, substantially equal to the requirements of this Act or to a person who, at the time of application for licensure, possesses individual qualifications that are substantially equivalent to the requirements of this Act

exists.quote: Subject to the provisions of this Act, the Department may: (a) authorize examinations to ascertain the qualifications and fitness of applicants for licensing as genetic counselors

national_certification.value: American Board of Genetic Counseling (ABGC) and American Board of Medical Genetics and Genomics (ABMGG)

regulatory_model.quote: no person shall, without a valid license as a genetic counselor issued by the Department (i) in any manner hold oneself out to the public as a genetic counselor under this Act; (ii) use in connection with a person's name or place of business the title "genetic counselor"... or (iii) offer to render or render to individuals, corporations, or the public genetic counseling services

credential_type.quote: "Genetic counselor" means a person licensed under this Act to engage in the practice of genetic counseling.

is_mandatory.quote: Any person who practices, offers to practice, attempts to practice, or holds oneself out to practice as a genetic counselor without being licensed or exempt under this Act shall, in addition to any other penalty provided by law, pay a civil penalty to the Department in an amount not to exceed $10,000 for each offense

title_protection.quote: no person shall, without a valid license as a genetic counselor issued by the Department (i) in any manner hold oneself out to the public as a genetic counselor under this Act; (ii) use in connection with a person's name or place of business the title "genetic counselor", "licensed genetic counselor", "gene counselor", "genetic consultant", or "genetic associate"

scope_protection.quote: no person shall, without a valid license as a genetic counselor issued by the Department... (iii) offer to render or render to individuals, corporations, or the public genetic counseling services if the words "genetic counselor" or "licensed genetic counselor" are used to describe the person offering to render or rendering them, or "genetic counseling" is used to describe the services rendered or offered to be rendered.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to maintain the confidentiality of any information received from a client, unless otherwise authorized or required by law.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Discipline by another governmental agency or jurisdiction for grounds substantially equivalent to those in this Section.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Discipline by another governmental agency or unit of government, by any jurisdiction of the United States, or by a foreign nation, if at least one of the grounds for the discipline is the same or substantially equivalent to those set forth in this Section.

disciplinary_grounds.quote: Directly or indirectly giving to or receiving from any person, firm, corporation, partnership, or association any fee, commission, rebate, or other form of compensation for any professional service not actually rendered.

disciplinary_grounds.quote: A finding by the Department that the licensee, after having the license placed on probationary status, has violated the terms of probation.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to refer a client to other health care professionals when the licensee is unable or unwilling to adequately support or serve the client.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to refer a client to other health care professionals when the licensee is unable or unwilling to adequately support or serve the client.

disciplinary_grounds.quote: Willfully failing to report an instance of suspected child abuse or neglect as required by the Abused and Neglected Child Reporting Act.

disciplinary_grounds.quote: Being named as a perpetrator in an indicated report by the Department of Children and Family Services pursuant to the Abused and Neglected Child Reporting Act, and upon proof by clear and convincing evidence that the licensee has caused a child to be an abused child or neglected child

disciplinary_grounds.description: Physical or mental disability, including deterioration through aging, resulting in inability to practice with reasonable judgment, skill, or safety.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Physical or mental disability, including deterioration through the aging process or loss of abilities and skills which results in the inability to practice the profession with reasonable judgment, skill, or safety.

definition_quote.value: "Genetic counseling" means the provision of services, which may include the ordering of genetic tests, to individuals, couples, groups, families, and organizations by one or more appropriately trained individuals to address the physical and psychological issues associated with the occurrence or risk of occurrence or recurrence of a genetic disorder, birth defect, disease, or potentially inherited or genetically influenced condition in an individual or a family.
definition_quote.quote: "Genetic counseling" means the provision of services, which may include the ordering of genetic tests, to individuals, couples, groups, families, and organizations by one or more appropriately trained individuals to address the physical and psychological issues associated with the occurrence or risk of occurrence or recurrence of a genetic disorder, birth defect, disease, or potentially inherited or genetically influenced condition in an individual or a family.

value: Estimating likelihood of occurrence or recurrence of birth defects or genetically influenced conditions
Obtaining and analyzing complete health history of person and family
Evaluating risks from exposure to mutagens or teratogens
Recommending genetic testing or other evaluations
Helping individuals/families appreciate medical, psychological, and social implications of a disorder
Facilitating exploration of risk perception and adjustment to genetic conditions
methods_authorized.quote: "Genetic counseling" consists of the following: (A) Estimating the likelihood of occurrence or recurrence of a birth defect or of any potentially inherited or genetically influenced condition... (B) Helping the individual, family, health care provider, or health care professional... (C) Facilitating an individual's or family's... exploration of the perception of risk

active_candidate_status_recognized.quote: A temporary license may be issued to an individual who has made application to the Department, has submitted evidence to the Department of admission to the certifying examination administered by the ABGC or the ABMGG or either of its successor agencies

temporary_license_supervisor_types.quote: "Qualified supervisor" means any person who is a licensed genetic counselor, as defined by rule, or a physician licensed to practice medicine in all its branches.

supervision_contract_required.quote: The qualified supervisor shall file written documentation with the Department of employment, discharge, or supervisory control of a genetic counselor at the time of employment, discharge, or assumption of supervision of a genetic counselor.

genetic_test_ordering_authority.quote: "Genetic counseling" means the provision of services, which may include the ordering of genetic tests

temporary_licensee_test_ordering_prohibi.quote: The holder of a temporary license shall practice only under the supervision of a qualified supervisor and may not have the authority to order genetic tests.

medicine_practice_exclusion.quote: Nothing in this Act shall be construed as permitting persons licensed as genetic counselors to engage in any manner in the practice of medicine in all its branches as defined by law in this State.

referral_to_physician_required_when_outs.quote: When, in the course of providing genetic counseling services to any person, a genetic counselor licensed under this Act finds any indication of a disease or condition that in the genetic counselor's professional judgment requires professional service outside the scope of practice as defined in this Act, the genetic counselor shall refer that person to a physician licensed to practice medicine in all of its branches.

federal_employee_exemption.quote: Nothing in this Act shall be construed to limit the services of a person, not licensed under the provisions of this Act, in the employ of a federal, State, county, or municipal agency or other political subdivision or not-for-profit corporation providing human services if (i) the services are a part of the duties in the person's salaried position, (ii) the services are performed solely on behalf of the person's employer, and (iii) that person does not in any manner represent oneself as or use the title of "genetic counselor" or "licensed genetic counselor".
